changes.from: How should the Android version share the engine? The core is Swift. Options: (a) build it with the Swift SDK for Android and call it from a Kotlin InputMethodService through JNI; (b) port the core to Kotlin (two copies to keep in step); (c) rewrite the core in Rust/C++ for every platform. Recommended: (a). Also: release channel (Google Play has a one-time developer fee) and whether to install the Android SDK/emulator on this Mac (several GB) for testing.
changes.to: 引擎共用方式选哪种:(a) 用 Swift SDK for Android 编译现有核心,Kotlin 输入法经 JNI 调用(推荐);(b) 移植为 Kotlin(两份代码需保持一致);(c) 用 Rust/C++ 重写给所有平台。另:是否现在开始、优先级。
